content: The overall results also clearly indicate that (i) there are differences in performance across different monolingual Multi-SimLex datasets, and (ii) unsupervised post-processing is universally useful, and can lead to huge improvements in correlation scores for many languages. In what follows, we also delve deeper into these analyses.
